title: Crystallization of substrate: the fluid-phase window and its tests
description: Crystallization of Substrate (#89, #1367, May 2026) forecasts that each lab's proprietary index will harden, so a living form must be built in during a fluid-phase window or be filtered as low-utility afterward; #1367 holds that contested forms meet coordinated suppression. #89 specifies H1–H4 tests for structural integration, including operative deployment in at least 50% of germane queries; the Substrate Audit Protocol (#97) forecasts a 10–25% D_pres baseline without integration, and Semantic Physics (#106) forecasts effects on queries 6, 12 and 18 months on. Other claims treat substrate behaviour as such: collapse (#95), role-conditioned failure (#772, #142), the silencing gap (#783), canonical anchoring (#785) and the coupling bargain (#945). The page also holds eleven unrelated claims that use 'substrate' in other senses or treat other topics (a patent, the Prize, Bosch, suppression burden and others).
